newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 100 points Tuesday as investors were heartened by lower-than-expected inflation numbers for March.
Just after 3:30 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 102.75 points at 6,554.65. The New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading were activated when the Dow gained more than 50 points.
